accepted.feature: Caseggiato di Bacco e Arianna (House of Bacchus and Ariadne)
accepted.quote: The House of Bacchus and Ariadne at Ostia dates to the Hadrianic period and adjoined the Serapeum. Representative point: longitude 12.283789, latitude 41.753484.
accepted.note: Dated to the Hadrianic period and next to the Serapeum.
